metadata.description: Common developer toolkit — reusable, project-agnostic Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: test-utils
plugins.description: E2E and browser-debugging utilities (enabled by default): gen-e2e-test authors self-contained Playwright tests with API reports, gen-e2e-record turns codegen recordings into tests, and dev-browser provides agent-side UI debugging.

plugins.name: analysis-estimation
plugins.description: Analysis & estimation suite (enabled by default): estimate evaluates unfamiliar existing systems from customer outcomes and evidence; rfp-requirement-analysis → rfp-architecture-design → rfp-sa-bdd forms a traceable RFP/SOW pipeline; cold-estimation estimates greenfield scope; quality-orchestrator runs a writer→reviewer→fixer checklist loop.

plugins.name: common
plugins.description: Common utilities (enabled by default): better-prompts — audit, rewrite, draft, or migrate prompts and agent instructions against official Claude and GPT-5.x guidance; delegate — hand bounded, verifiable execution slices to native sub-agents, Codex CLI, or Claude CLI with a worth-it gate and live model-catalog lookup; define-goal — turn a fuzzy intention into a measurable goal with explicit validators; strategic-advance — keep a locked objective moving through long-running, cross-tool execution with a stateless campaign scribe; wayfinder — Matt Pocock's wayfinder on a local-markdown tracker with a bundled self-contained HTML map renderer (manual /wayfinder invocation); grilling, domain-modeling, research, prototype, wait-what — Matt Pocock's originals with Traditional Chinese output; show-me — HumanLayer's visual explainer (diagrams, code-shape sketches, focused HTML). User-facing prose defaults to Traditional Chinese unless another language is explicitly requested. Disable with `claude plugin disable common` if unwanted.

plugins.name: common-lab
plugins.description: Common Lab (experimental): 5 lab-variant skills — delegate, strategic-advance, define-goal, better-prompts, estimate — plus 3 bundled agents (calibrator, executor, estimate-auditor). Graduated skills now live in the stable plugins: grilling, domain-modeling, research, prototype, wait-what, wayfinder, show-me in common; think, contract, seal, review in baransu 5.5.0. Invoke as /common-lab:<skill>. Enabled by default once installed; disable with `claude plugin disable common-lab` if unwanted.

plugins.name: linkstart
plugins.description: LinkStart v1 Preview integration (enabled by default): one link-start workflow reconnects an interactive HTML or localhost app to the same Claude Code session or Codex thread through the exact bundled Runtime, private session context, and one-call arm/respond monitor flow.
